1.

O God, Thy Son’s atoning work, Thy grace’s perfection, Hath made that we may approach Thee In full righteousness.

2.

As Thine own beloved children We rejoice before Thee, Since Jesus, Thine elect, Himself offered on the cross.

3.

Sweet the confidence, peace, and joy Thou dost impart to our heart; Our spirit hath its refuge In the light, where Thou art.

4.

There in the rich grace of Thy purpose The sons Thou hast appointed, May share as joint-heirs All Thou hast given to the Son.
